items.summary: Approve containment-only execution. Update existing reconciliation, failure-containment, measurement, bounded security-evidence, and private-launch workstreams only. Create no new proposals, change requests, telemetry requests, spend, requeues, deployments, permission or configuration changes, or external outreach. Preserve unavailable revenue, attribution, ROI, margin, causal lift, cost-to-learn, budget exposure, and operational health as unknown.

Reconcile existing execution records only. Document canonical lineage, deduplication, ownership, validation gates, rollback paths, queue eligibility, and terminal dispositions before any requeue or new production work.
Continue repair-or-close review for existing failures without requeue. Require root cause, smallest isolated repair, focused validation, rollback, ownership, and deduplication evidence.

Continue scheduled measurement using existing source-dated impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, site-attributed commission, and available AI cost only. Do not add instrumentation or request duplicate telemetry; preserve missing financial and operational fields as unknown.

Continue bounded read-only security evidence capture from authorized metadata and retained artifacts. Keep missing access, secrets, isolation, release, monitoring, incident, TLS, dependency, and disclosure evidence unknown; retain private launch gates.

Keep the gated product private. Continue existing read-only rights, data-flow, retention, consent, vendor, incident, accuracy, and measurement evidence work; keep the permission request unsent pending owner and counsel authorization.

No new queue item is justified: the actionability snapshot has no unblocked candidate, 27 deployed improvements await measurement, and existing failure repairs remain open. Technical metrics and AI usage are operating evidence, not financial return.
